name: catalys-modules
description: Catalys modules. Each module lives in modules/<name> with its own AGENTS.md.

scripts.test:ui: node -e "try{require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH||'playwright')}catch{console.error('test:ui needs Playwright: npm ci (root devDependency) or PLAYWRIGHT_PATH');process.exit(2)}" && node --test modules/stock-watch/test/ui-helpers.test.js modules/stock-watch/test/ui-stores.test.js modules/stock-watch/test/ui-trial.test.js modules/stock-watch/test/ui-people.test.js modules/stock-watch/test/ui-import.test.js modules/stock-watch/test/ui-money.test.js modules/stock-watch/test/ui-review.test.js modules/stock-watch/test/ui-returns.test.js modules/stock-watch/test/ui-brand.test.js
scripts.stamp: git diff --quiet HEAD && git rev-parse HEAD > modules/stock-watch/BUILD_SHA && echo "BUILD_SHA $(cat modules/stock-watch/BUILD_SHA)" || (echo 'stamp: commit first (uncommitted changes)' >&2; exit 1)
